name: Pierce Boland
bio: In May 1885 Pierce Boland brought word that Dr. Robarts had successfully amputated an injured man's leg. In March 1886 he went to Helena.

moments.label: Brought news of a successful amputation

mentions: ….  Many distinguished guests have come to the metropolis lately. Among them we noticed Charlie Mason, Nitche, Boland and other bloods.  Jack Bullion rides a good horse when he shows up in town.  Billy Paddock has come out as a hunter and guide since he quit cow punching. He intends to…

…re and started immediately on horse-back for the scene of the accident.  [A later report brought in by Pierce Boland is that the leg was successfully amputated by Dr. Robarts and that the patient was doing as well as could be expected. At the time Pierce left the ball was still lodged…
Pierce Boland has gone to Helena, where times are said to be picking up wonderfully.
